title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
part_text: 7. Is deeply concerned that Haiti’s criminal-political crisis will fuel further migration; strongly supports, in this regard, the Dominican Republic’s firm policy of returning illegal immigrants in order to protect its public health, education and social systems and its local culture, avoid mass settlement and prevent social tension; calls on regional actors to play a constructive role in promoting stability, mediation and assistance for the Haitian people;
